feeds.title: Therapy for Black Girls Blog
feeds.description: The Therapy for Black Girls podcast is a weekly conversation with Dr. Joy Harden Bradford, a licensed psychologist in Atlanta, Georgia, about all things mental health, personal development, and all the small decisions we can make to become the best possible version of ourselves.

feeds.title: Inclusive Therapists Blog
feeds.description: Find the best Mental Health Care Blog Posts now. The most recent Blog Posts are posted by Therapists, Counselors, and Psychologists near you. A safer, simpler way to find a therapist who gets you. Celebrating all identities and bodies.

feeds.title: Benevolent Health Blog
feeds.description: Benevolent Health Blogs and podcasts encourage everyday conversations on mental health to improve emotional well-being across workplaces and communities. Benevolent Health specializes in providing expertise in mental health through consulting, coaching, and mentoring

feeds.title: Black Women's Health Imperative Blog
feeds.description: Get the latest from the Black Women's Health Imperative Blog. Changing black women's lives through advocacy and public policy, health education, research and leadership development, the Black Women's Imperative works to advance health equity and social justice for Black women across the lifespan.

feeds.title: Buck Black Therapy Blog
feeds.description: I am a Licensed Clinical Social Worker and an AASECT Certified Sex Therapist focused on couples therapy, which is comprised of sex therapy, communication skills, anger management, and even financial counseling. Individual therapy is also provided for stress and anger management. Check out my blog for mental health tips, answers to your answers and more!

feeds.title: Mental Health Africa Blog
feeds.description: Mental Health Africa was born out of the COVID-19 lockdowns around the world in 2020. A married couple, one a psychologist and the other a creative director, were having a conversation about the impact of the pandemic on mental health. Explore resources and advice for better mental health from professionals in the blog.

feeds.title: Black Mental Wellness Blog
feeds.description: The mission of Black Mental Wellness, Corp. is to provide access to evidence-based information and resources about mental health and behavioral health topics from a Black perspective, to highlight and increase the diversity of mental health professionals, and to decrease the mental health stigma in the Black community. Wade through their blog and learn more about mental health, wellness from a variety of experts in the mental health field, health and fitness, clergy, the beauty industry, and so much more.

feeds.title: Black Girls Smile News
feeds.description: Black Girls Smile Inc. has been recognized as one of the leading organizations focusing on black female mental wellness.

feeds.title: Eustress Inc. Blog
feeds.description: Eustress, Inc. was born out of the desire to bring awareness to the importance of acknowledging, improving, and preserving mental health, a topic often marked by stigma and denial, particularly in the black community. We help people acknowledge negative stressors they may face and the impact they have on mental health additionally.

feeds.title: Black Students Mental Health Blog
feeds.description: My name is Ronalds Busulwa (Mental Health Practitioner, Addictions Counsellor, Researcher, Mental Health Lecturer). In this blog, we have put together several resources which you may find useful to help you cope with the pressures of university life to flourish. Resources include mental health services, self-help tips, guides, tools, and activities to support and improve mental health.

feeds.title: Black Health Matters Blog
feeds.description: Black Health Matters has been brewing as a concept for a number of years. The recent attention brought by COVID and the Black Lives Matters movements to the lives and health of Black communities has pushed the project into reality. Explore our blog for mental health-related articles, techniques for better mental health and more!

feeds.title: Therapy For Black Kids Blog
feeds.description: The T4BK blog offers tips for parents and information on mental health awareness. This blog is maintained by Therapy for Black Kids. Therapy for Black Kids (T4BK) was founded by Dr. Erlanger 'Earl' Turner. As a psychologist and mental health advocate, Dr. Earl is passionate about changing the narratives around seeking therapy in the Black community.

feeds.title: Alberta Black Therapists Network Blog
feeds.description: The Alberta Black Therapists Network (ABTN) is made up of a group of Black licensed and regulated professionals from various interdisciplinary backgrounds working in the field of mental health and addictions. We aim to increase emotional wellness and the application of self-care skills such as self-awareness, self-confidence, positive thinking, goal setting, responsible decision-making, and healthy relationships.

feeds.title: Anxious Black Girls Blog
feeds.description: Anxious Black Girls provides therapy and wellness services to Black women and girls. Our blog provides ongoing and current information about anxiety, depression, and other mental health disorders that impact the population of women we serve.
